Name: Street
Description: Payout: +1 VP per building adjacent to your Streets. Count each building once.

Name: House
Description: Place: +1 VP per adjacent Home building. Payout: +1 coin if a Shop is within 2 tiles.

Name: Cottage
Description: Place: +1 VP per adjacent park tile or Lake. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to a park tile or Lake.

Name: Shop
Description: Payout: +1 coin per Home building within 2 tiles, max 3.

Name: Farm
Description: Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to another Farm or Orchard.

Name: Park
Description: Park size 1. Place: score the park's increase.

Name: Wild Garden
Description: Park size 1. Place: score the park's increase.

Name: Grant
Description: Play: gain 4 coins, then discard this card.

Name: Avenue
Description: Counts as 2 tiles for Longest Road. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to at least 2 buildings.

Name: Roundabout
Description: When anyone builds beside this: gain 1 VP.

Name: Orchard
Description: Park size 1. Place: score the park's increase. Payout: +1 coin if adjacent to a Farm or another Orchard.

Name: Lake
Description: Payout: each adjacent Home building earns its owner 1 coin. Counts as a park neighbor, but is not a park tile.

Name: Vineyard
Description: Payout: nothing for its first 2 payouts; then +3 coins each payout.

Name: Startup
Description: Payout: +1 coin the first time, +2 the second, then +3 each time.

Name: Market
Description: Payout: +1 coin per Shop you own within 2 tiles, max 4.

Name: Contractor
Description: When you build a House card or Shop: gain 1 coin, up to 2 coins per round.

Name: Apartment
Description: Place: +2 VP per adjacent Home building. Payout: +2 coins if a Shop is within 2 tiles.

Name: Cafe
Description: Payout: +1 coin per adjacent Home building or Shop, max 3. End: +2 VP if adjacent to a park tile or Lake.

Name: Fountain
Description: Park size 2. Place: score the park's increase.

Name: Factory
Description: Payout: +2 coins. End: each adjacent Home building or Cafe loses its owner 1 VP, including yours.

Name: Sapling
Description: Park size 1. Place: score the park's increase. After its second payout, grows to size 3 and scores the increase again.

Name: Bank
Description: Payout: +2 coins.

Name: Town Hall
Description: Payout: +2 coins if you own at least 3 Civic buildings, including this.

Name: Museum
Description: End: +1 VP per other Culture building you own, max 8.

Name: Chamber of Commerce
Description: Payout: +1 coin per 2 Trade buildings you own, max 4 coins. Includes this.

Name: Warehouse
Description: Round start: gain a Street if your hand has room. When you build your first Street each round: gain 1 coin.

Name: Builders' Yard
Description: Round start: gain a Street or a random Common, if your hand has room. Choose which before the round starts.

Name: Hospital
Description: Each round: one random Home building has an emergency. The nearest Hospital within 4 tiles earns its owner 1 VP. Ties go to the earlier Hospital.

Name: Tourist Office
Description: Payout: +1 coin per Culture building you own, max 3. Includes this.

Name: Tax Office
Description: Payout: +1 coin per 4 Home buildings you own.

Name: Depot
Description: Payout: +1 coin per 5 road tiles you own, max 4 coins.

Name: School
Description: Payout: +1 coin per Home building you own within 2 tiles, max 4.

Name: Granary
Description: Payout: +1 coin per Farm or Orchard you own, max 3.

Name: Stadium
Description: Payout: each adjacent Home building earns its owner 1 coin; each adjacent Cafe loses its owner 1 coin. End: +1 VP per adjacent Home building.

Name: Airport
Description: Payout: +3 coins. End: each Home building within 2 tiles loses its owner 1 VP. Maximum loss: 3 VP per player across all Airports.

Name: Skyscraper
Description: Requires at least 2 adjacent buildings. End: +1 VP per other building within 2 tiles, max 6.

Name: Industrial Estate
Description: Payout: +1 coin per Industry building you own, max 5. Includes this.

Name: Housing Authority
Description: End: +1 VP per 3 Home buildings you own, max 6. Includes this.

Name: Eco Council
Description: End: +1 VP per 2 Nature buildings you own, max 8; then subtract 2 VP per Industry building you own, minimum 0. Includes this in Nature.

Name: Gardener's Guild
Description: When you build a park tile: gain 1 coin.

Name: Architect's Studio
Description: When you build your first building each round beside one of your buildings: gain 2 coins. This Studio can trigger its own effect.

Name: Renovation
Description: Play: replace one of your buildings with a different building card from your hand. Discard both cards.

Name: Ribbon Cutting
Description: Play: gain 1 coin per building you built this round, max 4, then discard this card.

Name: Rush Hour
Description: Play: this payout, gain 1 extra coin per Shop you own, max 4. Discard this card. Once per round.

Name: Land Claim
Description: Play: reserve an empty tile until next round starts. Only you may build there. Discard this card.

Name: Central Station
Description: Payout: +1 coin per Shop or Market you own, max 4.

Name: Senate
Description: End: +2 VP for each tag you have on at least 3 buildings, max 12. Includes this.

Name: Monument
Description: End: +6 VP.
